content: We got a list of templates. Need one that corresponds to SN2: breaking C-Cl, forming C-N. The product is the given molecule? The target molecule is COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1. It contains a side chain with CN4CC(F)C4 attached to aromatic via CH2. Likely the precursor is the same but with a Cl on that CH2 (i.e., benzyl chloride). So we need a template that does SN2 on alkyl halide to amine. Look at returned templates: many are not SN2. Need to search again with more appropriate criteria: functional_groups_broken: alkyl halide, functional_groups_formed: primary amines maybe. Also bonds broken: C-Cl, bonds formed: C-N.
